summary.fr: INSTAGRAM · Unfollow Not Followers — repérez les comptes sans follow-back.
summary.en-US: INSTAGRAM · Unfollow Not Followers — find accounts that don't follow you back.

description.fr:
Unfollow Not Followers INSTAGRAM vous aide à nettoyer vos abonnements en identifiant les comptes que vous suivez sans follow-back.

Extension exclusivement pour INSTAGRAM :
• Fonctionne uniquement sur instagram.com
• Analyse progressive de vos followers et abonnements
• Résultats affichés par lots pour une utilisation fluide
• Désabonnement en un clic avec délai de sécurité automatique
• Aucun mot de passe collecté — utilise votre session Instagram ouverte

L'extension fonctionne localement dans votre navigateur. Aucune donnée personnelle n'est envoyée à un serveur externe.

Politique de confidentialité : https://lxcasm.github.io/unfollow-not-followers/confidentialite.html
description.en-US:
Unfollow Not Followers INSTAGRAM helps you clean up your following list by identifying accounts you follow that don't follow you back.

INSTAGRAM-only extension:
• Works only on instagram.com
• Progressive analysis of your followers and following
• Results shown in batches for a smooth experience
• One-click unfollow with automatic safety delay
• No password collected — uses your open Instagram session

The extension runs locally in your browser. No personal data is sent to external servers.

Privacy policy: https://lxcasm.github.io/unfollow-not-followers/confidentialite.html

version.approval_notes: This extension uses Instagram's internal APIs through the user's existing browser session (cookies/CSRF). It does not collect or transmit passwords or personal data to external servers. All processing happens locally. Monetization: 15 free unfollows per session, then the user must wait 8 seconds while a sponsor link to the developer profile (https://github.com/lxcasm) is shown before starting a new analysis. No third-party ad network is used.
